data.title: England vs Spain Prediction, Lineups, Betting Tips & Odds | UEFA Nations League 2026-27
data.content:
Pedro Porro has withdrawn through injury, making Eric Garcia the likely right-back. Joan Garcia is also unavailable, Gavi is suspended for the opener and Marcos Llorente has retired from international football, but Luis de la Fuente still retains 22 members of his World Cup-winning squad.

### Predicted Lineups

England (4-2-3-1)  
Pickford; Quansah, Konsa, Guehi, O'Reilly; Anderson, Scott; Saka, Bellingham, Gordon; Kane [...] Thomas Tuchel must rebuild his midfield without Declan Rice and Kobbie Mainoo, while Cole Palmer, Marcus Rashford and Tino Livramento have also withdrawn. Elliot Anderson and Alex Scott could therefore form an inexperienced double pivot, with James Garner and Morgan Gibbs-White offering alternatives. [...] England welcome world and European champions Spain to Wembley on Saturday evening for the opening match of their 2026-27 UEFA Nations League campaigns.

The Group A3 contest is the first meeting since Spain defeated the Three Lions in the Euro 2024 final. Croatia and Czechia complete a competitive section from which the leading two nations will qualify for the quarter-finals.

data.title: Kosovo vs Republic of Ireland: Lineups, Prediction, Betting Tips
data.content:
Ireland missed out on the World Cup after a penalty shoot-out defeat to Czechia but have produced a string of encouraging outings. Wins against Grenada and Qatar were followed by a draw with Canada back in June. Troy Parrott spearheads the attack and will be the man they look to for goals.
